name: Merge overlapping intervals
specification: Given a list of closed numeric intervals [start,end], sort by start and merge intervals that overlap or touch at an endpoint. Reject reversed or malformed intervals. Return an empty list for empty input.
expected_complexity: O(n log n) time due to sorting; O(n) output space.

test_cases.description: Overlapping intervals merge; disjoint interval remains separate.
Closed intervals that meet at an endpoint are merged.
Empty input returns an empty list.
Duplicate intervals collapse to one interval.
Unsorted and nested intervals are normalized and merged.
A large ordered set produces a single merged interval.
